definition: שָׁבִיס noun [masculine] front-band (Mishna id.; Levy NHWB iv. 498 ; al. compare Arabic , literally a sun , of small glass neck-ornament We Skizzen iii. 145 ; Hebrew perhaps a diminutive, see Ges «GKC:86»§ 86 note); — plural הַשְּׁבִיסִים Isa 3:18 , in list of women's finery.
